an6.140:1.1: ariyāya vimuttiyā. Imehi kho bhikkhave chahi dhammehi samannāgato Sāraggo upāsako Tathāgate niṭṭhaṃ gato amataddaso amataṃ sacchikatvā iriyatī ti. CXXI. Rāgassa bhikkhave abhiññāya cha dhammā bhāvetabbā. Katame cha? Dassanānuttariyaṃ, savanānuttariyaṃ, lābhānuttariyaṃ, sikkhānuttariyaṃ, pāricariyānuttariyaṃ, anussatānuttariyaṃ. Rāgassa bhikkhave abhiññāya ime cha dhammā bhāvetabbā ti.
